caseNameFull: Cottom v. California Johnson v. Burke, Warden Copestick v. Rhay, Penitentiary Superintendent Hunter v. Prasse, Correctional Commissioner and Selz v. California

opinions.text: Motions for leave to file petitions for writs of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
